description: This source file implements the AAH_TXSender class, which manages RTP packet transmission, including socket creation, endpoint registration, packet sending, retry buffer management, and heartbeat signaling within the Android media framework.

classes.name: AAH_TXSender
classes.description: Manages RTP packet transmission, socket communication, endpoint registration, retry buffers, and heartbeat signaling.

classes.name: AAH_TXSender::Endpoint
classes.description: Represents a network endpoint with IP address and port.

classes.name: AAH_TXSender::EndpointState
classes.description: Maintains state for each registered endpoint, including retry buffer, sequence numbers, and program ID.

classes.name: AAH_TXSender::CircularBuffer
classes.description: A template class implementing a circular buffer for storing packets or other data.

classes.name: AAH_TXSender::RetryReceiver
classes.description: A thread class handling incoming retry requests and NAKs over UDP socket.

methods.name: AAH_TXSender::GetInstance
methods.description: Singleton pattern to obtain the global instance of AAH_TXSender, initializing socket and thread resources if needed.

methods.name: AAH_TXSender::~AAH_TXSender
methods.description: Destructor that stops threads, unregisters handlers, and closes socket.

methods.name: AAH_TXSender::getNextEpoch
methods.description: Generates the next epoch number for new endpoints, ensuring uniqueness.

methods.name: AAH_TXSender::registerEndpoint
methods.description: Registers a new endpoint, starting heartbeat and buffer trimming if first endpoint.

methods.name: AAH_TXSender::unregisterEndpoint
methods.description: Unregisters an endpoint, decrementing reference count.

methods.name: AAH_TXSender::onMessageReceived
methods.description: Handles incoming messages for sending packets, trimming buffers, and sending heartbeats.

methods.name: AAH_TXSender::onSendPacket
methods.description: Prepares and sends a TRTP packet to a specified endpoint.

methods.name: AAH_TXSender::doSendPacket_l
methods.description: Internal method to send a packet to an endpoint, updating sequence and retry buffer.

methods.name: AAH_TXSender::trimRetryBuffers
methods.description: Removes expired packets from retry buffers and cleans up unused endpoints.

methods.name: AAH_TXSender::sendHeartbeats
methods.description: Sends heartbeat packets to all registered endpoints if appropriate.

methods.name: AAH_TXSender::shouldSendHeartbeats_l
methods.description: Checks if it's time to send heartbeat messages based on last sent time.

methods.name: AAH_TXSender::RetryReceiver::handleRetryRequest
